doc.description:
Communication module for use in anchorless network where the UWB modules are attached to MAVs and need to communicate on-board values with each other (for purposes such as relative localization, coordination, or collision avoidance). This module must be used together with a UWB hardware such as the Decawave DWM1000 running the appropriate communication code, which runs on an intermediate MCU like a ATmega 328 as found on e.g., an Arduino Pro Mini board. The code that must run on this extra electronics can be found at: https://github.com/tudelft/uwb_swarm_extender An example file to flash the extension board can be found in examples/UWB_localization_v1_0/UWB_localization_v1_0.ino
Dynamic UWB Addressing:
Set dynamic_address to TRUE to use the AC_ID as the UWB address (non-sequential, unique per drone). When enabled, the flight controller sends the AC_ID encoded as a float at startup, which the UWB module decodes and uses as its address. This feature requires compatible code on the UWB module (see documentation).

configure.name: UWB_SWARM_UART
configure.description: UART on Flightcontroller on which the UWB Swarm extension PCB is connected

configure.name: UWB_SWARM_DYNAMIC_ADDRESS
configure.description: Set to TRUE to use AC_ID as UWB address (dynamic, non-sequential).
